# Commonware Crates (v2026.9.0)

- **commonware-actor** (actor): Safely coordinate concurrent components.
- **commonware-bench** (bench): Abstract benchmark workloads.
- **commonware-bridge** (examples/bridge): Send succinct consensus certificates between two networks.
- **commonware-broadcast** (broadcast): Disseminate data over a wide-area network.
- **commonware-broadcast-fuzz** (broadcast/fuzz): No description available
- **commonware-chat** (examples/chat): Send encrypted messages to a group of friends using commonware-cryptography and commonware-p2p.
- **commonware-codec** (codec): Serialize structured data.
- **commonware-codec-fuzz** (codec/fuzz): No description available
- **commonware-codec-macros** (codec/macros): Augment the development of commonware-codec with procedural macros.
- **commonware-coding** (coding): Encode data to enable recovery from a subset of fragments.
- **commonware-coding-fuzz** (coding/fuzz): No description available
- **commonware-collector** (collector): Collect responses to committable requests.
- **commonware-collector-fuzz** (collector/fuzz): No description available
- **commonware-conformance** (conformance): Automatically assert the stability of encoding and mechanisms over time.
- **commonware-conformance-macros** (conformance/macros): Augment the development of commonware-conformance with procedural macros.
- **commonware-consensus** (consensus): Order opaque messages in a Byzantine environment.
- **commonware-consensus-fuzz** (consensus/fuzz): No description available
- **commonware-cryptography** (cryptography): Generate keys, sign arbitrary messages, and deterministically verify signatures.
- **commonware-cryptography-curve25519** (cryptography/curve25519): Perform Curve25519 field/group arithmetic, Ed25519 signing and verification, and X25519 key exchange.
- **commonware-cryptography-curve25519-fuzz** (cryptography/curve25519/fuzz): No description available
- **commonware-cryptography-fuzz** (cryptography/fuzz): No description available
- **commonware-deployer** (deployer): Deploy infrastructure across cloud providers.
- **commonware-estimator** (examples/estimator): Simulate mechanism performance under realistic network conditions.
- **commonware-flood** (examples/flood): Spam peers deployed to AWS EC2 with random messages.
- **commonware-formatting** (formatting): Format and parse encoded data.
- **commonware-glue** (glue): Default constructions that span multiple primitives.
- **commonware-invariants** (invariants): Define and exercise invariants.
- **commonware-log** (examples/log): Commit to a secret log and agree to its hash.
- **commonware-macros** (macros): Augment the development of primitives with procedural macros.
- **commonware-macros-impl** (macros/impl): Augment the development of commonware-macros with procedural macros.
- **commonware-math** (math): Create and manipulate mathematical objects.
- **commonware-math-fuzz** (math/fuzz): No description available
- **commonware-p2p** (p2p): Communicate with authenticated peers over encrypted connections.
- **commonware-p2p-fuzz** (p2p/fuzz): No description available
- **commonware-parallel** (parallel): Parallelize fold operations with pluggable execution strategies.
- **commonware-reshare** (examples/reshare): Reshare a threshold secret over an epoched log.
- **commonware-resolver** (resolver): Resolve data identified by a fixed-length key.
- **commonware-runtime** (runtime): Execute asynchronous tasks with a configurable scheduler.
- **commonware-runtime-fuzz** (runtime/fuzz): No description available
- **commonware-runtime-macros** (runtime/macros): Augment the development of commonware-runtime with procedural macros.
- **commonware-storage** (storage): Persist and retrieve data from an abstract store.
- **commonware-storage-fuzz** (storage/fuzz): No description available
- **commonware-stream** (stream): Exchange messages over arbitrary transport.
- **commonware-stream-fuzz** (stream/fuzz): No description available
- **commonware-utils** (utils): Leverage common functionality across multiple primitives.
- **commonware-utils-fuzz** (utils/fuzz): No description available

Use `get_crate_readme` to get detailed documentation for any crate. Use the path in parentheses with `list_files` or `get_file` to browse crate contents.
